description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusController class within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. The controller extends an abstract Vue.js controller, indicating its role in managing the employment status view, specifically setting up a Vue component named 'employment-status-list' during pre-rendering.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the employment status management view in the admin plugin. It prepares a Vue component for rendering employment status list.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Lifecycle method called before rendering the view; it initializes the component with a Vue component named 'employment-status-list'.
